parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key that is used to filter the query results.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the key that is used to filter the query results.

parameters.name: MinDuration
parameters.description: The minimum amount of time consumed by traces. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: OperationName
parameters.description: The name of the traced span.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to sort the query results in chronological order or reverse chronological order. Default value: `false`.

*   `true`: sorts the query results in reverse chronological order.
*   `false`: sorts the query results in chronological order.

parameters.name: ServiceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the host where the application resides.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. The following system preset fields are provided:

*   serverApp: the name of the server application.
*   clientApp: the name of the client application.
*   service: the name of the operation.
*   rpc: the type of the call.
*   msOfSpan: the duration exceeds a specific value.
*   clientIp: the IP address of the client.
*   serverIp: the IP address of the server.
*   isError: specifies whether the call is abnormal.
*   hasTprof: contains only thread profiling.
